charts.title: TOI-2049 b: orbits around TOI-2049
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-2049's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-2049 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Guenther et al. 2026 (2026AJ....172...54G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname GUENTHER_ET_AL_2026): P 5.303468 d

charts.title: TOI-2049 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-2049 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (57, 77, 84) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 314835525, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 14 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 76 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 20-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 14 min early; 20-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 25 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
